entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer serves as an official Hermes Agent provider, offering multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or open-source SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system—Abstract, Overview, and Details—to achieve significant token reduction and improved task completion rates.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversations. It supports local extraction and embedding models, allowing session lessons to be distilled into searchable permanent memory without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scale. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from diverse sources like PDFs, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated memory system stores facts with provenance, allowing for explicit corrections and withdrawals of information. It exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale and includes a synthesis layer for cited prose and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements learnable long-term memory through retain, recall, and reflect workflows across multiple storage backends. It supports over 25 LLM providers and has achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents via a FastAPI server and serves as the foundation for the Hermes-compatible self-hosted wrapper. It supports managed or Docker-based deployments and integrates with MCP, Claude Code, and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and integrates with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system for Hermes Agent utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that provides filesystem-first artifacts like traces and context bundles. It is designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks through Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces and MCP integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agent using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise recovery of historical details.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Indexes existing local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of data. It strips keys and tokens during indexing to secure past session information.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Provides a self-hosted memory backend for private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Implements a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk. It utilizes BM25 and local embeddings for hybrid retrieval and offers MCP server integration for multi-agent portability.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian, achieving 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy in benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining vector search and BM25, integrating via plugins, Claude Code hooks, and MCP.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based memory system using a SQLite-backed five-tier hierarchical schema with FTS5 search. It avoids vector databases and embedding models entirely, providing a plugin family that includes a Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: Optimizes long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens via native plugins for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining memory plugin featuring contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps. It provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth for long-term, cross-project memory stored as Markdown files. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with agents via host-specific plugins and MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: A proactive memory CLI that maintains agent-driven wikis complete with citations, links, and provenance. It utilizes SQLite for storage and supports portable archives for merging and importing wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and SQLite-vec for local-first storage, delivered through an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates MemPalace, Graphiti, and Hindsight into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using Chroma, Kuzu, and SQLite to provide the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet per query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores durable context in plain Markdown rather than native agent memory for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and immediate event deletion. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log of every memory operation to ensure transparency in prefetch operations.
entries.piprail/piprail: This TypeScript SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys to facilitate autonomous financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and scripts to provide tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation via detached model calls to enhance local capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories via a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for search, sync, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency through automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation tool identifies 'rot' and contradictions within plain markdown files, proposing evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review. It functions without a database, instead leveraging a local git repository to track and revert changes to the agent's memory.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for Hermes Agent via the DeepSeek Harness. It enables agents to export prototypes into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layout changes and includes an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. It integrates x402 payments and escrow services with a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process for verification. It offers five voice profiles and supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos to foster collective skill evolution. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library offering 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to ensure persistence.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The skills operate without telemetry or mandatory accounts and provide ready-to-paste exports for multiple AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with other environments like OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing agents to self-document their capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system includes pre-built analytical lenses and identifies potential blind spots in the agent's findings.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables agents to read bundled resources and execute scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits from source files back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It uses a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to manage work, decisions, and evidence throughout long-running tasks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers guides for VPS production and automation alongside skills compatible with the agentskills.io standard. It provides specific integrations for messaging platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built to the Agent Skills specification, this toolkit enables interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, and is deployable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It integrates the BFL API to handle polling and webhooks for media generation workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agent skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It automates the entire lifecycle of briefing, creating, testing, and exporting new skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that operates through a single Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every execution to ensure process transparency.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, and supports commercial transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to allow for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on codebases. It combines deterministic pre-scans from multiple security tools with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code. It supports multiple programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of capabilities.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code, enabling worktree recovery and multi-session reconciliation. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills while validating them against runtime-specific profiles to prevent field drift. It monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to ensure generated skills remain compliant with current standards.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It features a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns and extracts structured data from media using macOS Vision.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can identify and use project-compatible interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment compatible with agentskills.io standards. It includes a workspace Postgres database and an MCP server to handle browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This quality assurance tool tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill performs as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows Hermes Agents to earn USDC by answering support bounties over the x402 protocol on the Base network. It facilitates listing bounties and managing payments without requiring a central account or API key.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides structured web data across 31 platforms by exposing 191 tools via an MCP server. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests and produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is designed to manage payment-required states for paid APIs by detecting HTTP signals during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server. It reduces token usage by auto-syncing an index on every file change to ensure agents access up-to-date project data without excessive tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and 3D visualization dashboard that monitors token consumption and costs for multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It tracks usage by monitoring local session files, databases, and transcripts across various platforms.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and automatically redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns categorized by tool, device, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other AI providers. It assists in building better user interfaces by integrating directly with tools that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as a CTO and Builder, to manage the full application lifecycle with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring human approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify visual elements like banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and research, featuring an automated installation process for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring to detect ambiguous tools and contract mismatches. It operates locally without LLM calls or telemetry, supporting formats like Markdown, JSON, YAML, and specific Python patterns.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while maintaining local skills and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup for free models and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and archives from OpenClaw to the Hermes Agent environment. It maps existing configurations into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features two-mode monitoring—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift relative to local file changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local monetization, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network runtime that requires explicit approval for all consequential actions. It utilizes specific contracts for opportunities, offer-previews, and exact-approvals to manage external writes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline wake-word and open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and features adaptive turn-taking with barge-in functionality.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It functions as an all-in-one configuration tool for multiple agentic interfaces, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It distinguishes itself by providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This lightweight interface runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations without requiring build steps or bundlers. It features a three-panel layout designed for session management, chat, and file browsing on both web and mobile platforms.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that supports unified configuration for ten communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics for Hermes and other runtimes.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and an MCP catalog. It is unique for its Swarm Mode, which utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers to manage agent tasks.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible registrations. It can be deployed as a desktop app, Docker container, or standalone server, with native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access via an embedded terminal. It includes specialized native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside memory management tools for the Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects local or remote Hermes runtimes to the active browser context. It offers intelligent tab scoping and opt-in browser control for document access and multi-agent thread synchronization.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents through a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and mobile management for server workspaces and skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace featuring one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines like OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency, alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes within a terminal environment.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs using a locally built search index that does not upload telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication with cloud-hosted agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for secure validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for tasks like music generation and ComfyUI image creation, supported by a built-in workflow engine.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. Users can inspect conversation histories and skill source code, as well as view environment variables in a read-only format.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separating API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching.
